audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Two conditions, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 2 and autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 7, are both recorded as caused by the gene TPP1 [e_6b22822b86fb] [e_ac0d73745bd0].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_6b22822b86fb] [e_ac0d73745bd0].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.9, the lower of the two gene links [e_222a8163593e].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_222a8163593e].
For neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 2, an observed feature is reduced activity of the TPP1 enzyme in tissue, seen in 2 of 2 cases in one report [e_d5e7f3585d7a].
A second feature, extra fluorescent storage material outside nerve cells, is curated at a lower confidence of 0.5 [e_54af47a2c8f8].
These edges do not show why one gene gives rise to two different conditions, and they list no symptoms for the ataxia, no studies and no treatments [e_222a8163593e] [e_ac0d73745bd0].
